note: The standard System 7.5.5 boot disk: tools-7.5.5 plus MacsBug 6.6.3 (in the System Folder; its folder in Utilities). Networking is 7.5.5's own MacTCP: Open Transport 1.1.2 (baked: open-transport-1.1.2) bombs at startup on the PPC machine (illegal instruction; PLAN.md P3), so it isn't on this universal disk.
